calismalar.baslik: Neural Message Passing for Quantum Chemistry
calismalar.gerekce: Unifies existing models into the Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) framework, the foundational paradigm for GNN molecular property prediction.
calismalar.alinti: we reformulate existing models into a single common framework we call Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs)

calismalar.baslik: MoleculeNet: A Benchmark for Molecular Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: Canonical benchmark that curates public molecular datasets, sets evaluation metrics, and provides open-source implementations of featurization and learning algorithms.
calismalar.alinti: MoleculeNet curates multiple public datasets, establishes metrics for evaluation, and offers high quality open-source implementations of multiple previously proposed molecular featurization and learning algorithms

calismalar.baslik: SchNet: A continuous-filter convolutional neural network for modeling quantum interactions
calismalar.gerekce: SchNet introduces continuous-filter convolutional layers for modeling quantum interactions in molecules, a foundational geometric architecture.
calismalar.alinti: We apply those layers in SchNet: a novel deep learning architecture modeling quantum interactions in molecules

calismalar.baslik: Directional Message Passing for Molecular Graphs
calismalar.gerekce: DimeNet proposes directional message passing that embeds messages between atoms, advancing geometric molecular GNNs.
calismalar.alinti: To alleviate this limitation we propose directional message passing, in which we embed the messages passed between atoms instead of the atoms themselves.

calismalar.baslik: SE(3)-Equivariant Graph Neural Networks for Data-Efficient and Accurate Interatomic Potentials
calismalar.gerekce: NequIP uses E(3)-equivariant convolutions on geometric tensors for data-efficient, accurate interatomic potentials, a landmark equivariant GNN.
calismalar.alinti: NequIP employs E(3)-equivariant convolutions for interactions of geometric tensors, resulting in a more information-rich and faithful representation of atomic environments.

calismalar.baslik: MACE: Higher Order Equivariant Message Passing Neural Networks for Fast and Accurate Force Fields
calismalar.gerekce: MACE uses higher-order equivariant messages; four-body messages reduce required message passing iterations to two for fast, accurate force fields.
calismalar.alinti: we show that using four-body messages reduces the required number of message passing iterations to just two

calismalar.baslik: Equivariant message passing for the prediction of tensorial properties and molecular spectra
calismalar.gerekce: Identifies limitations of invariant representations and extends message passing to rotationally equivariant representations for tensorial properties and spectra.
calismalar.alinti: We identify limitations of invariant representations as a major reason and extend the message passing formulation to rotationally equivariant representations.

calismalar.baslik: Strategies for Pre-training Graph Neural Networks
calismalar.gerekce: Foundational strategy for pre-training GNNs on data-abundant related tasks, then fine-tuning on downstream tasks.
calismalar.alinti: An effective approach to this challenge is to pre-train a model on related tasks where data is abundant, and then fine-tune it on a downstream task of interest.

calismalar.baslik: Self-Supervised Graph Transformer on Large-Scale Molecular Data
calismalar.gerekce: GROVER integrates message passing networks into a Transformer-style architecture with self-supervision on large-scale molecular data.
calismalar.alinti: GROVER integrates Message Passing Networks into the Transformer-style architecture to deliver a class of more expressive encoders of molecules.

calismalar.baslik: Molecular Contrastive Learning of Representations via Graph Neural Networks
calismalar.gerekce: MolCLR establishes contrastive self-supervised pre-training of GNN encoders on molecule graphs.
calismalar.alinti: In MolCLR pre-training, we build molecule graphs and develop GNN encoders to learn differentiable representations.

calismalar.baslik: 3D Infomax improves GNNs for Molecular Property Prediction
calismalar.gerekce: 3D Infomax pre-trains models to reason about molecular geometry given only 2D graphs, bridging 2D and 3D representations.
calismalar.alinti: We propose pre-training a model to reason about the geometry of molecules given only their 2D molecular graphs.

calismalar.baslik: Uni-Mol: A Universal 3D Molecular Representation Learning Framework
calismalar.gerekce: Uni-Mol is a universal 3D molecular representation learning framework combining a 3D transformer with large-scale molecular pretraining.

calismalar.baslik: Do Transformers Really Perform Bad for Graph Representation?
calismalar.gerekce: Graphormer shows that transformers with simple structural encodings can model graph-structured data effectively, a central graph transformer.
calismalar.alinti: we propose several simple yet effective structural encoding methods to help Graphormer better model graph-structured data

calismalar.baslik: Recipe for a General, Powerful, Scalable Graph Transformer
calismalar.gerekce: GPS recipe builds general, powerful, scalable graph Transformers with linear complexity and state-of-the-art results across diverse benchmarks.
calismalar.alinti: We propose a recipe on how to build a general, powerful, scalable (GPS) graph Transformer with linear complexity and state-of-the-art results on a diverse set of benchmarks.

calismalar.baslik: How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?
calismalar.gerekce: Characterizes discriminative power of popular GNN variants, showing they cannot distinguish certain simple graph structures; foundational expressivity theory.
calismalar.alinti: Our results characterize the discriminative power of popular GNN variants, such as Graph Convolutional Networks and GraphSAGE, and show that they cannot learn to distinguish certain simple graph structures.

calismalar.baslik: Weisfeiler and Leman Go Neural: Higher-order Graph Neural Networks
calismalar.gerekce: Shows GNNs match 1-WL expressiveness and proposes higher-order GNNs to go beyond that limit.
calismalar.alinti: We show that GNNs have the same expressiveness as the $1$-WL in terms of distinguishing non-isomorphic (sub-)graphs.

calismalar.baslik: Analyzing Learned Molecular Representations for Property Prediction
calismalar.gerekce: Extensive benchmark of learned molecular representations on 19 public and 16 proprietary industrial datasets across diverse chemical endpoints.
calismalar.alinti: In this paper, we benchmark models extensively on 19 public and 16 proprietary industrial datasets spanning a wide variety of chemical endpoints.

calismalar.baslik: Molecular Graph Convolutions: Moving Beyond Fingerprints
calismalar.gerekce: Early molecular graph convolutions, which do not outperform all fingerprint methods yet represent a new virtual screening paradigm.
calismalar.alinti: Although graph convolutions do not outperform all fingerprint-based methods, they (along with other graph-based methods) represent a new paradigm in ligand-based virtual screening

calismalar.baslik: Quantum chemistry structures and properties of 134 kilo molecules
calismalar.gerekce: The QM9 dataset of quantum chemistry structures and properties for 134 kilo molecules is a standard molecular benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: Therapeutics Data Commons: Machine Learning Datasets and Tasks for Drug Discovery and Development
calismalar.gerekce: Therapeutics Data Commons provides drug discovery datasets, meaningful data splits, and systematic model evaluation strategies.
calismalar.alinti: TDC also provides an ecosystem of tools and community resources, including 33 data functions and types of meaningful data splits, 23 strategies for systematic model evaluation

calismalar.baslik: Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs
calismalar.gerekce: Open Graph Benchmark includes molecular graphs and highlights out-of-distribution generalization challenges under realistic data splits.
calismalar.alinti: Our experiments suggest that OGB datasets present significant challenges of scalability to large-scale graphs and out-of-distribution generalization under realistic data splits

calismalar.baslik: Exposing the limitations of molecular machine learning with activity cliffs.
calismalar.gerekce: Benchmarks 720 machine and deep learning models on activity cliff compounds across 30 targets, exposing limitations of molecular ML.
calismalar.alinti: We benchmarked a total of 720 machine and deep learning models on curated bioactivity data from 30 macromolecular targets for their performance on activity cliff compounds.

calismalar.baslik: Evaluating Machine Learning Models for Molecular Property Prediction: Performance and Robustness on Out-of-Distribution Data
calismalar.gerekce: Evaluates twelve models, including random forests and GNNs, for out-of-distribution performance and robustness in molecular property prediction.
calismalar.alinti: we investigate and evaluate the performance of twelve machine learning models, including classical approaches like random forests, as well as graph neural network (GNN) methods

calismalar.baslik: Real-World Molecular Out-Of-Distribution: Specification and Investigation
calismalar.gerekce: Specifies real-world molecular distribution shifts, finding performance drops up to 60% and uncertainty calibration drops up to 40%.
calismalar.alinti: We find that these shifts can cause performance to drop by up to 60% and uncertainty calibration by up to 40%.

calismalar.baslik: Uncertainty Quantification Using Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction
calismalar.gerekce: Compares uncertainty quantification methods for molecular property prediction; none is unequivocally superior or reliably ranks errors across datasets.
calismalar.alinti: Our experiments show that none of the methods we tested is unequivocally superior to all others, and none produces a particularly reliable ranking of errors across multiple data sets.

calismalar.baslik: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for an Accurate and Interpretable Prediction of Material Properties
calismalar.gerekce: CGCNN learns material properties directly from atom connections in crystals, a seminal GNN application to materials.
calismalar.alinti: we develop a crystal graph convolutional neural networks framework to directly learn material properties from the connection of atoms in the crystal

calismalar.baslik: A survey of geometric graph neural networks: data structures, models and applications
calismalar.gerekce: Surveys geometric GNNs, covering data structures, models, and applications for graphs with translation, rotation, and reflection symmetries.
calismalar.alinti: geometric graphs often exhibit physical symmetries of translations, rotations, and reflections, making them ineffectively processed

calismalar.baslik: Uncovering Neural Scaling Laws in Molecular Representation Learning
calismalar.gerekce: Addresses the open problem of neural scaling laws in molecular representation learning.

calismalar.baslik: MolPROP: Molecular Property prediction with multimodal language and graph fusion
calismalar.gerekce: MolPROP fuses language models and graphs for property prediction, benchmarked on seven scaffold-split MoleculeNet datasets, exemplifying LLM integration.
calismalar.alinti: We benchmark the MolPROP suite of models on seven scaffold split MoleculeNet datasets and compare with state-of-the-art architectures

calismalar.baslik: Quantitative evaluation of explainable graph neural networks for molecular property prediction
calismalar.gerekce: Provides quantitative evaluation of explainable GNNs for molecular property prediction, addressing the interpretability open problem.
